description:
Apply pending .cs edits to the connected Unity Editor through hot-patching, usually in 1-2 seconds without domain reload. Supports Edit Mode and Play Mode. Requires hot reload, the sidecar compiler, and a compatible Unity plugin.

The tool classifies edits and verifies call sites. Inspect which changes actually applied; cold edits and .asmdef changes require unity_recompile. Fix reported compile errors before retrying. Reflection/string-based bindings and inlined Release call sites can retain old behavior; follow the reported recovery action. Debug optimization avoids inlining-related delays.

Files are already saved. Hot patches last until domain reload; run unity_recompile in Edit Mode after a completed burst of edits, before test discovery or serialization/Inspector verification, or when directed. New virtualized fields may use default values on existing objects and appear in the Inspector only after a full compile. Automatic convergence can also occur after idle periods or leaving Play Mode.

paths.description: Optional .cs paths (absolute or project-relative) to hot reload. Default: every .cs file edited since the last recompile.
